metadata.notes: Smoke test for the multilingual nemotron-3.5 variant (prompt_kernel + es-ES routing). Audio is a synthesized 3 s placeholder tone (not real Spanish speech) checked in alongside this manifest until a CC0 Spanish utterance can be sourced. WER/CER are pinned to 1.0 so the comparator does not gate on transcription quality; this case verifies plumbing (audio decode -> prompt_kernel -> decoder) end-to-end, not ASR accuracy. Replace data/nemotron_es_sample.{wav,txt} with a real CC0 sample (e.g. Mozilla Common Voice es) and tighten thresholds (suggested wer=0.40, cer=0.30) once available.
